messages:
alex: Kickoff — need to lock acceptance gates for model onboarding this sprint. Customer-driven asks for next-gen models are piling up, and we need a clear prioritization + canary plan.
maya: Quick q — do we want hard perf numbers or relative to a baseline? My vote: baseline + regression threshold.
sam: Sales note: several customers asked about pinning guarantees during migration. Can we offer a 90-day pin opt-in?
rachel: From QA side: we need customer eval sets + adversarial prompts (at least 3 customers) and automated A/B fuzz tests before any wide rollout.
tony: Infra check — canary lanes available: 5% traffic cohort + option for reserved pinned capacity for top 2 customers. Autoscale policy looks fine.
alex: Thinking launch gates: perf, quality, infra, rollback plan, comms. Anything missing?
maya: I'll draft gates. Suggested checklist: perf bench (quant + fp variants), unit tests for KV cache, end-to-end latency, failing-case SLOs, cost delta thresholds.
sam: Pin exceptions question — some legal teams want 1-year pins. Is that supported?
rachel: We'll allow exceptions with CSM + Legal signoff and a documented risk ack (template: CN-EXC-YYYY).
alex: Action items: maya -> spec gates doc; rachel -> collect customer eval sets; tony -> reserve canary slots; sam -> list priority customers requesting pins.
maya: Draft will include minimal benchmark harness snippet for reproducibility:
```bash
./run_bench --model $MODEL --seq 1024 --batch 8 --warmup 50 --iters 500
```
maya: Also add reproducibility notes (seed lists, traffic profile, machine types).
tony: FYI cost note — canary infra + reserved pools estimate ~ $5k/month. Finance approval required for large cohorts.
sam: I can bundle that ask into renewal conversations. Which customers are top priority for the 90-day pins?
alex: Priority order: AcmeCorp, SparkDocs, HealthCo. If Legal needs 1yr, escalate to leadership for approval.
rachel: Migration runway proposal: phased ramp 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 7 days with automated rollback if quality metric drops >3% vs baseline.
maya: Also recommend a short-lived compatibility shim flag for embedding/schema changes — API toggle for 30 days.
alex: Good. I'll consolidate gates into a checklist doc and add rollout timelines. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://confluence.internal/model-onboard/gates-2959876543
sam: :thumbsup:
maya: :thumbsup:
tony: :thumbsup:
rachel: :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks all — I'll send a single PR with the spec and schedule the PM review slot.
